item.text: I’ll check the figures in the linked 10-Q and calculate all five results in order.

All source amounts are **USD millions**. Sections below are in Part I, Item 1 of [Apple’s FY2025 Q2 Form 10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019325000057/aapl-20250329.htm).

| ID | Final answer | Filing section and periods used | Calculation with source values |
|---|---|---|---|
| **SEC-CMP-006** | **5.08%** growth | Condensed Consolidated Statements of Operations, p. 1; three months ended March 29, 2025 and March 30, 2024 | (2025 sales 95,359 − 2024 sales 90,753) ÷ 90,753 × 100 |
| **SEC-CMP-007** | **31.03%** operating margin | Statements of Operations, p. 1; three months ended March 29, 2025 | Operating income 29,589 ÷ total net sales 95,359 × 100 |
| **SEC-CMP-008** | **0.8209:1** current ratio | Condensed Consolidated Balance Sheets, p. 3; March 29, 2025 | Current assets 118,674 ÷ current liabilities 144,571 |
| **SEC-CMP-009** | **27.94%** | Statements of Operations, p. 1; three months ended March 29, 2025 | Services sales 26,645 ÷ total net sales 95,359 × 100 |
| **SEC-CMP-010** | **Q1 sales: USD 124,300 million; sequential growth: −23.28%** | Statements of Operations, p. 1; six and three months ended March 29, 2025 | Q1 = six-month sales 219,659 − Q2 sales 95,359 = 124,300. Growth = (95,359 − 124,300) ÷ 124,300 × 100. |
